title: Page arithmetic
description:
Work out pages for allocations the way an operating system does.

```
page size 4096
allocate 1 byte     -> 1 page  (4095 wasted)
allocate 10000      -> 3 pages (2288 wasted)
address 0x12345 is in page 0x12, offset 0x345
```
hints: `address >> 12` is the page and `address & 0xFFF` the offset.
requirements: `pagesFor(bytes)` rounds up; the waste is `pages * 4096 - bytes`.
`pageOf(address)` and `offsetIn(address)` with shifts and masks (a page is 2^12 bytes).
Print a table for a few sizes.
stretch: Do the same for 2 MB "large pages" and compare the waste.
